renderings.value: Express 'in addition to', 'besides', 'not only... but also'.

The ～上に grammar point is used to indicate that there is an additional piece of information or situation besides the first one. It can be translated as 'in addition to', 'besides', or 'not only... but also'. It can be used with verbs, い-adjectives, な-adjectives, and nouns.
Verb-plain + 上に, い-Adjective + 上に, な-Adjective + な上に, Noun + の上に
Neutral "in addition to" - pairs two related facts/qualities.
In addition to being smart, he is also good at sports.
This dress is not only beautiful but also affordable.
Besides being kind, she is also good at cooking.
Not only is he a company president, but he is also a famous writer.
